text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: U-Um—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Would you please — be my Trainer……!

—It was so sudden. 
I never dreamed she would ask for an exclusive contract.
Curren Bouquetd'or was the girl who always decorated the Trainers' break room with flowers. A Horsegirl with a gentle, mild-mannered personality.

But that very gentleness wasn't suited for competition——
at least, that was the general consensus among the other Trainers, and I couldn't help but worry about her.
Since she had been hesitating over whether to even continue racing, I assumed she wouldn't be debuting anytime soon.
choice_data_list: Um, so does this mean you're thinking of debuting?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes…! I will debut. Aiming for victory — I will run…!
choice_data_list: …Are you sure you're no longer hesitating?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah — I… I can't say I have confidence. 
But… —I am no longer hesitating.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—There is something I want to achieve. 
And to do that, I have to win… That's why, I'll run—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Would you please come watch me at the Semiannual Race Meet? 
To see if I truly have the resolve to win—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want you to see it through to the end…!
…She and I are cut from the same cloth. I've been hesitating too, worried that my own lack of experience wouldn't be enough to support her.

But — her soft, earthy-brown eyes wavered, 
and her tightly clenched fists were trembling slightly.

Seeing her desperately muster her courage to plead with me, 
I felt her sincerity. —There was no doubt that something inside her had changed.
choice_data_list: Understood. I'll be there to watch

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—! I'll do my very best…!

—The Semiannual Race Meet. 
Curren Bouquetd'or was running in the 1600m turf race. 
And there—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text: Here she comes, Almond Eye! Even among all the Horsegirls debuting this year, she's completely in a league of her own!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ai! Give us another one of those breathtaking final sprints of yours!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Such overwhelming cheers… They've all come here to see Ai. Going up against someone drawing this much attention… ngh, but—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: U-Um… Ai! I look forward to racing against you today…!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. But I'm not going to lose to anyone! 
Not even you, Bouquet!
—The race unfolded with Almond Eye missing the break, allowing Curren Bouquetd'or to secure a favorable position in the leading pack.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—! But I can still recover! 
The real showdown starts on the final straight!
If things continued like this, Curren Bouquetd'or actually had a chance at victory. However, on the final straight—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ugh…!
Curren Bouquetd'or flinched, as if physically pushed back by Ai's sheer momentum. Her face twisted in distress, just like it always did.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (…What an incredible fighting spirit. —I feel like I'm going to be overwhelmed by Ai's sheer willpower. But—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (In order to take their hand — I must show them my resolve!)

She held her ground, refusing to be shaken off by Almond Eye—
a racer whose obsession with victory surpassed all others!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: For my very first victory — the first flower in my bouquet of glory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaah!
—A sharp light sparked in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah… I couldn't… win… —Even though I wanted to win this one… of all races… so badly…  —Ugh, uuu…

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: …Bouquet. Your running today was completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: If you can change this much, you can definitely become even stronger! So let's race again. Out there in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer. I'm so sorry… 
Even though you came all this way to watch me, I ended up losing…
choice_data_list: <size=40>Don't be sorry. That was an amazing run</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I wanted to win so I could show you my resolve. It's so frustrating…
choice_data_list: You've finally found the desire to win, haven't you?
You've finally found the desire to win, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Trainer. …While I was struggling with whether to continue racing, you were always there, stayed by my side.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Not just for me, but for every Horsegirl — you hold absolutely nothing back, pouring your time, your skills, and your entire heart into supporting them.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: There is no Trainer as wonderful as you. I want to show everyone just how incredible you are — through my running.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: …Even though I still can't offer you a single bloom of victory just yet. But if I'm with you — I know I can do my best.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And then, I will gather up victories, until they completely overflow from my hands.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ——I want to bring you a radiant, golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So, I beg of you——
Please, be my Trainer…!
…Her tear-filled eyes wavered. And yet, though wracked with anxiety, her gaze remained fixed straight on me.
choice_data_list: <size=40>(This must be her very first act of courage)</size>

text_block_list.text: If I let this opportunity slip by, her talents will likely wither without ever blossoming. But more than anything—
choice_data_list: —I want to be that person for you, too
—I want to be that person for you, too

text_block_list.text: I want to answer her resolve. She has chosen to take on this challenge with me, even if it means changing who she is.
choice_data_list: <size=36>I will strive to become the best Trainer for you!</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ——! ……Trainer——!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
…Yes. 
Please take good care of me——!

She smiled softly — gently, like a flower coming into bloom. 
—I swore in my heart to help this radiant smile bloom beautifully.
